products.name: Weights & Biases
products.note: ML experiment tracking; model registry; artifact lineage; MLOps governance

profile_text.body:
Weights & Biases is an AI developer platform that the company describes as a system of record for training AI models and developing AI applications. The platform is aimed at machine learning teams and covers experiment tracking, model registry, artifact lineage, and MLOps governance. It holds certifications under ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27017:2015, and ISO/IEC 27018:2019, and is compliant with SOC 2 and HIPAA standards, with alignment to GDPR requirements and support for NIST 800-53 compliance.

The platform includes a product called Weave, which a quoted user describes as allowing engineers to add a library to existing code and immediately gain visibility into the generative AI portions of their products, with reporting on AI performance built into the same environment they already use for experiment tracking. The held facts list Weights & Biases under the Coding and Developer Tools category, consistent with its focus on the machine learning development workflow. No litigation, SEC filings, or MCP registry presence are recorded for the company.
